source: Knock model v4 (knock calibration phase B, 2026-10-19): the parameter set of the map generator's knock replay, tau = scale * A * (OI/100)^on_exponent * (p/1 atm)^-pressure_exponent * exp(activation_k/T) / (1 - x_res)^dilution_exponent, integrated Livengood-Wu (ps/engine_cycle/knock.h), x_res = the end gas's residual mass fraction at IVC. The compiled defaults in ps/engine_cycle/knock_model.h equal this file entry by entry (tests/unit/test_knock_cal_turbo.cpp 'KCB knock model file'). Fit: least squares of theta_kl - measured spark over the envelope rows of the Toyota A25A (EPA NVFEL, 17 rows, NA, KV1-BC) and the Honda L15B7 on EPA Tier 3 E10 (EPA NVFEL, 15 rows, MAP 98-196 kPa) at MEASURED boundary conditions (trapped air = measured air, measured intake temperature, lambda and cam phases, exhaust reservoir at ambient), constrained to every A25A row within +-5 deg and to the light-load no-knock rows of every EPA turbo package (tests/support/fixtures/epa_turbo/*_light_rows.json: the model's knock limit at most 2 deg [AS] below min(measured spark, MBT)). The measured ECU spark is the knock limit minus the OEM's own margin; like KV1-BC the fit treats measured spark as theta_kl with margin 0, so the calibrated model absorbs the OEM margin. Held out: the envelope rows of the Honda L15B7 on Tier 2 E0 and of the Ford 2.7 EcoBoost (four packages); reported: Ford 1.6 EcoBoost, Mazda 2.5 T. Decision note: vault PHYS-069, docs/data_formats/engine.md 'Knock limit'.

prefactor_s.source: [AS] Douaud & Eyzat 1978 (SAE 780080) via Heywood 1988 sec. 9.6.2, not verified locally

octane_index_k.source: [AS] OI = RON - K*(RON - MON); K 0.5 = the anti-knock index (R+M)/2. A pressure/temperature-dependent K (SAE 2012-01-1634) was considered and rejected: the test fuels' sensitivity S is 7.5-9, so the measured MAP trend would need K about -3

prefactor_scale.source: [M] fitted (see source); v2 1.26 at the literature n and B, v3 0.012

pressure_exponent.source: [M] fitted; literature 1.7, v3 1.05. Constrained optimum flat over 0.93-0.98

activation_k.source: [M] fitted; literature 3800 K, v3 5800 K. Constrained optimum flat over 6000-6200 K; above 6400 K the A25A rows leave +-5 deg

dilution_exponent.source: [M] fitted under the light-load no-knock constraint (the fit rows alone cannot identify it: residual fractions 0.03-0.10). Form: a residual/EGR dilution factor on the ignition rate as used in EGR knock-integral correlations (e.g. SAE 2012-01-0707, not verified locally); the value is EFFECTIVE - it also absorbs the model's residual heating of the end gas - and is not a chemical constant
